summary: Read-Only Planning Revision 10 for Prompt 28 (Audit & Data Retention Subsystem). Fully resolves all Revision 9 blockers: distinguishes statement timeouts from total transaction deadlines, formalizes recovery and batch ownership state machines, aligns failure counter transactional persistence, specifies worker lifecycle and graceful shutdown, hardens migration/seed failure behaviors, implements strict server allowlist registries for dynamic targets, establishes point-in-time completion boundaries, sanitizes all JSON/text payloads with strict byte limits, and adds the 10 recommended acceptance tests.
